text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's October. Propelled by the glow of<n>the limelight
and high expectations, a<n>certain Umamusume
breaks into a<n>frenzied run.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What incredible speed! Silence<n>Suzuka pulls even
further away from<n>the pack with her runaway style!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Is it even safe runnin' that<n>fast?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's made it past the giant zelkova<n>tree, but the
other runners are hot on<n>her trail...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But no! She ramps up her speed even<n>more on the
straight! No one can<n>close the gap!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This is amazing! Go, Suzuka! Go, go,gooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka holds the lead all the<n>way to the
finish line! A fitting run for<n>the Otherworldly
Front-Runner!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Since that trip to Hong Kong, all her<n>races have
been incredible as all<n>get-out! She's the cream of
the<n>Umamusume crop, I tell ya what!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's a real strength to her<n>running, but that's
not all. Her style<n>captures the hearts of those who
witness it and refuses to let go.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Suzuka's off to the<n>winner's circle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna give her a big ol' victory<n>squeeze!
C'mon, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, we can't even get to<n>the
sidelines—the swarm of Suzuka's<n>celebrating fans
is too vast to push<n>through.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I'm reminded of the hold<n>that Silence
Suzuka has on<n>everyone's hearts.
